VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station

VR.title: KRVR Supports Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming For SteamVR Games
VR.summary: KRVR app enables Apple Vision Pro users to play SteamVR games with foveated streaming, enhancing gaming performance on the new headset.

VR.summary: James Cameron’s Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC to enhance its production capabilities for films and immersive experiences.

VR.summary: Meta Horizon+ adds new games this month, including musical rhythm and narrative puzzle experiences, aimed at expanding its subscription service.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is available at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play promotion, running until June 10.

AI.summary: Microsoft introduced Scout, an AI personal assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 apps, enhancing productivity for businesses.

AI.summary: Project Solara, a new OS for AI agent gadgets, was announced by Microsoft, aiming to power innovative agent-driven experiences.

NFL.summary: Sean McVay confirmed the Rams' interest in bringing back Aaron Donald, who is considering a return to the team.

NFL.summary: The 49ers signed safety Ashtyn Davis to a one-year deal, bolstering their defensive lineup.

NFL.summary: Ravens WR Rashod Bateman is absent from organized team activities due to personal matters, raising concerns about his status.
